subject: Invoice routing and delegation: portal primary vs email copy + VAT evidence
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta@acmecorp.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Invoice routing and signed invoice requirement

Hi Laura,

We're finalizing the AP onboarding checklist and have a couple of quick questions before we flip the switch:

- Who will actually publish/send invoices to Acme? Do you push invoices into our portal (integration) or do you email PDF copies to ap@acmecorp.com?
- Our compliance team requires a signed PDF with an authorized signature for invoices over $10k — is a digitally-signed PDF acceptable or do you need a wet signature?
- We also need VAT registration evidence (EU VAT certificate) attached to the first invoice. Can we upload that to a secure link or do you prefer us to email it?
- PO number to appear on invoice: 45231 (attached). Payment terms are Net30.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can set up vendor in our system.

Thanks,
Marta Gomez
AP Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: Acme_PO_45231.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.example
To: Marta Gomez <marta@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice routing and signed invoice requirement

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Short version: we support both, and we can match whatever reduces friction for your AP team. Details below.

Option A (preferred for scale): Redwood publishes invoices directly into your AP portal (SFTP/API/webhook). We can push UBL/CSV/encapsulated PDF and mark Acme as primary recipient. In this mode we also optionally send an email copy to ap@acmecorp.com for manual reconciliation.

Option B: Redwood emails a signed PDF to your AP address (we can attach a digitally-signed PDF with our authorized signatory).

On the VAT evidence and signed PDF: we can accept an uploaded VAT certificate via a secure upload link (I'll share), and we can attach a digitally-signed PDF for invoices > $10k. If you require a notarized wet signature we may need to handle that on an exception basis (we've done this for a small number of enterprise customers).

Proposal: for the first month, we'll do portal publish as primary plus email copy so your team can validate fields. If everything lines up we'll keep portal primary and drop email copies after a 30-day verification window.

Next steps for us:
- Kimberly (cc'd) will share the Redwood e-invoice schema and sample invoice.
- Please upload the Acme VAT cert to the secure link I will send, or reply with the PDF attached.
- Confirm whether you want email copies to continue after the first invoice.

Laura Bennett
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Invoice-Sample-202607.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@acmecorp.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.example
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice routing and signed invoice requirement

Hi Marta — looping in a couple items from our side so we can complete vendor set up: 

1) Can you confirm whether Acme wants portal-as-source (we push) or email-as-source (you treat our email as primary)? Your AP system's preference will determine the acknowledgement flow (700ms webhook vs email ack).

2) For portal push we need the following fields in your PO/receiver mapping: remit_to_name, remit_to_address, VAT_ID, PO_number, legal_entity_id. If you have a sample CSV for mapping please attach. I attached our e-invoice schema for reference.

3) Regarding the signed invoice: we can produce a digitally-signed PDF (PKCS7 signature) appended to the PDF. That satisfies most audits. Please let us know if your audit team insists on a wet signature.

4) Payment terms: we have you on NET30 by default but can accommodate NET45 for specific contracts — confirm if you want NET30.

I'll generate the portal onboarding link once we confirm portal preference and VAT upload method.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-einvoice-schema.csv (text/csv, 7KB)

Thanks Laura / Kimberly — quick replies from Acme AP: 

- Portal primary works best for us. Please push into our portal (SFTP) and send an email copy to ap@acmecorp.com for the initial 60 days. After the verification window we can stop the email copies.
- Digital signature (PKCS7) is fine for our compliance team. No wet signature required at this stage.
- We've uploaded the VAT certificate to the secure upload you sent earlier (or attached here). You should find Acme_VAT_Certificate.pdf attached.
- Attached: Acme_PO_45231.pdf (confirmed) and Acme_VAT_Certificate.pdf. Please confirm the invoice will include PO 45231 and remit-to details. Payment terms NET30.
- We would like the DocuSign for invoice authorization to be completed by our legal contact; please send the DocuSign to legal@acmecorp.com.

Appreciate it — once you confirm the portal connection details we'll schedule a short validation call (15 minutes) next week.

Best,
Marta Gomez
AP Manager, Acme Corp
